s0122 has 授勞崇光總督; 勞 is Lao, so 勞崇光 is Lao Chongguang. Luo is a mistranslation of the surname; the proposed idiomatic corrects only that name.

The same Chinese 勞崇光 requires Lao Chongguang in the literal field. Luo misreads 勞; the proposed replacement is accurate and otherwise unchanged.

As educational commissioner of Shuntian he rooted out abuses and ran a strict administration; during his tenure he was promoted repeatedly, eventually to grand tutor and grand secretary of the Grand Secretariat.

As educational commissioner of Shuntian he rooted out abuses and ran a strict administration; during his tenure he was promoted repeatedly, eventually to Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent and academician of the Grand Secretariat.

s0005 has 累擢詹事、內閣學士. 詹事 is Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent, not grand tutor (太傅/太子太傅); 內閣學士 is academician of the Grand Secretariat, not grand secretary (大學士). The proposed titles restore the Qing offices.
